Q_uncertainties: Original mass uncertainties preserved; covariance not available; no derived Q uncertainty claimed.

neutrino_mean_source.scope: Fixed solar-profile means, including thermal/ionization effects; not recomputed per zone.

domain: 10<T_MK<16; fixed rho/V; solar EC approximation; effective beta-delayed two-alpha B8 channel. No pep/hep/CNOII/screening/transport/stellar structure.
